chunks.text: This projector's parts cost a hundred and five pounds twenty. About twenty pounds of it is overspent.
Customers don't buy parts. They buy what parts do. Every part gets a job: an active verb and a measurable noun. The lamp?
Then the FAST diagram links them. Ask how, to the right. Ask why, to the left.
Unwanted functions, like heat, drag in cost: fans, filters and shielding. Five pounds eighty-nine a projector.
Put a cost on every function and rank them. Thirty per cent of the functions carry seventy-eight per cent of the cost.
Find out where the £20 went in the full video, and learn free at valueengineeringhub.com.
